quality_acceptance.full_replacement: No confirmed material errors or lost relevant bills across the covered roles, including large contexts and scans; secondary and revision coverage must be stated, not assumed.
quality_acceptance.triage: No confirmed high-confidence false negatives at production confidence threshold 0.8; uncertain fragments must pass to full analysis.
quality_acceptance.analysis: Preserve material dates, amounts, negation, eligibility, exceptions, and proposal-versus-decision distinction. JSON validity and agreement alone are insufficient.
quality_acceptance.calibration: Use only the preregistered calibration split, then evaluate the fixed prompt on the heldout split. Report before/after results.

baseline_limits: Saved full-analysis references cover 19 Opus 5.5 and 5 GPT-5.1 outputs; no fresh paid baseline inference.
Text triage references are historical Haiku 4.5, not current Sonnet 5. They are comparison aids, not independent ground truth.
Eight saved reanalysis texts have no reconstructable previous analysis; they test current-text analysis only. Three saved revisions and two controlled revisions include prior descriptions.
Author metadata is reconstructed in some corpus cases; the saved supplied text is exact, but some metadata and prompt versions differ from historical baseline requests.
Baseline outputs are not treated as infallible; disagreements require supplied-text audit.
A finite selected sample cannot certify unchanged quality on every future bill.
money: Every new generation is a Batch request. Reserve all unsent planned batches as well as active ones; add no calibration work beyond the $2 total ceiling.
calibration_reporting_limits: The original calibration/heldout split remains recorded unchanged. Later precision_v1, max_v2 and triage_v1 prompts use exploratory feedback from already reviewed errors, including some original heldout cases; their aggregate rerun results must not be reported as an untouched blind validation score.
New joint, precision, max_v2 and triage guard contexts were fixed before their own answers, but deliberately target known error categories rather than forming an independent random sample.

The return-to-Poland guard is a recheck of known classification instability, not a new independent test. Direct inspection of the production rubric makes score 2 defensible for entry/exit without a change to the residence permit; the earlier regression interpretation was corrected in the source audit.
Report source-supported repairs, persistent defects and introduced regressions separately; a higher percentage of historical-reference agreement alone is not proof of unchanged legal quality.

change_review_v1 is an exploratory recheck of all eleven prior controls after a raw full-context whitespace false positive. Original raw full-corpus review inputs contain justification and are stress tests. Separately added production-prepared cases use the actual diff_laws bodies/hunks and current eligibility limits; the production caller already filters zero-hunk spacing and bypasses review above 60000 combined characters.
